company_info.size: 450-800+ employees (approximately 450 as of 2025; expanded to 800+ by early 2026)
company_info.industry_info: Enterprise AI and Large Language Models. Cohere specializes in foundation AI models and end-to-end products for enterprises, with particular focus on regulated industries (finance, healthcare, manufacturing, energy) and the public sector. Their key product is the North platform, a secure AI workspace for creating and deploying AI agents and automations.
company_info.recent_news: April 2026: Acquired German AI firm Aleph Alpha. May 2026: Launched Command A+ model. June 2026: Partnered with S&P Global to embed financial data into North platform. February 2026: Reached $240M annual recurring revenue milestone. Company anticipated for 2026 IPO. Recent partnerships with major enterprises including RBC, Saab AB, and Hanwha Ocean.
company_info.company_culture: Per Teamblind (49 verified reviews, August 2026): Overall rating 3.6/5. Strengths: Compensation/benefits rated 3.9/5; employees highlight great colleagues, work-life balance, interesting work, and growth opportunities; free food and perks. Challenges: Management communication rated 2.8/5 (lowest category); some reports of unclear direction and fragmented cross-organizational collaboration. Overall sentiment: talented team environment with areas for improvement in leadership communication.
company_info.any_related_information: Cohere was founded in 2019 by Aidan Gomez (CEO), Nick Frosst, and Ivan Zhang—all former Google Brain researchers who contributed to the transformer architecture. Headquartered in Toronto with global offices in London, NYC, San Francisco, Montreal, Paris, Berlin, and Seoul. Has raised $1.54B+ in total funding from investors including NVIDIA, AMD, Oracle, Salesforce, PSP Investments, and Radical Ventures. The role focuses on North, Cohere's flagship product launched in August 2025 (early access January 2025), which is gaining significant enterprise traction. The Agents & Automations team is core to North's platform strategy.

location: Remote-friendly; headquarters in Toronto with offices in London, New York City, San Francisco, Montreal, Paris, Berlin, and Seoul.
